title: Strata Context Pack v1
description: What an AI may be given to answer one question: checked facts, each with its citation and source, what was left out (over budget) and what was quarantined (failed a check). Strata writes it (POST /api/ctx/{id}/pack, MCP context_for_question). Any model can answer from it; any number in the answer that is not in the facts is wrong.

data_as_of.description: When the data behind the facts was last loaded.

citation.description: Where it comes from: table.column [key], metric:name, a link, a note.

source.description: from the data | computed from the data | data check | meaning, checked against the data | your note

metric.description: The certified metric that answered the number, when one did.
